title: Harnack inequality for double-phase functionals with Muckenhoupt-type growth functions
summary: We investigate a general class of variational integrals under a structural condition imposed on the double-phase function, recently introduced in~\cite{ADKO2026}. In this setting, the strong Harnack inequality for non-negative local quasi-minimizers is established via an appropriate De Giorgi-type iteration argument.
